description: Defines the ProjectDocument entity class that maps to the 'project_documents' table, representing metadata for files/documents linked to a project in the system.

classes.name: ProjectDocument
classes.description: Entity class representing metadata for project-linked documents and files.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the document.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the document.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates the document with a project.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the document.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the storage path of the document.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the document.
